bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo="/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$repo/scripts"
echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo "USERBOT_ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo "USERBOT_SOURCE_PRESENT=$(test -f "$repo/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" && echo yes || echo no)"
if test -f "$repo/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py";then
 echo "USERBOT_SOURCE_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$repo/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
 echo "USERBOT_SOURCE_ACTION_CHAT=$(grep -q chat_selector_smoke "$repo/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" && echo yes || echo no)"
 echo "USERBOT_SOURCE_ACTION_PROFILE=$(grep -q profile_button_smoke "$repo/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" && echo yes || echo no)"
fi
echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "SOURCE_DIRTY=$(test -z "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py)" && echo no || echo yes)"
echo "USERBOT_SOCKET=$(test -S "$repo/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "BOT_IMAGE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
{ echo "USERBOT_CHAT_INVITE_PREFLIGHT=OBSERVED"; echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"; echo "USERBOT_FILE_PRESENT=$(test -f "$repo/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" && echo yes || echo no)"; echo "USERBOT_ACTION_PRESENT=$(grep -q chat_selector_smoke "$repo/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)"; } | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
